title: SUMMARIZE over the fact table groups by a column of a related table and returns only the values in use

source.quote: A product that has never been sold does not appear, because there are no corresponding transactions for it in Sales .
source.supports: grouping Sales by a Product column gives only the values some Sales row reaches

source.quote: groupBy_columnName must be either in table or in a related table to table .

derivation: Sales rows by product colour (Bike and Helmet are Red, Lock is Blue, Scooter is Green): rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 are Red, rows 4, 6 are Blue, none is Green. So the groups are Red and Blue; Green (Scooter, never sold) is absent. The column keeps its model name.
